single_judge_limitation: With GLM and Doubao both ENGINEERING_UNAVAILABLE, the 23 open-task semantic endpoint rests on Qwen-Max as the SOLE machine judge. Judge-bias probing is reduced to: (a) deterministic-subset agreement on the 17 deterministic-eligible tasks (Qwen vs the deterministic score), and (b) the candidate-family score-deviation audit. The qwen-vs-glm leave-one-judge-out sensitivity arm is NOT available. This is the strongest form of the 'machine-judged semantic quality, without human validation' limitation already declared in Amendment-002; it does not block the freeze but must be reported in the paper.
